purpose: Verify that an Applicant can submit a complete patent application with valid documents and receive a unique ID and Submitted status.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role and a submission draft can be created; supporting documents are PDF, under 50 MB, and malware-free.
action_or_input: Applicant enters title, abstract, detailed description, claims, inventor information, and supporting documents, then confirms submission.
expected_result: PMS validates completeness and document rules (PDF, <50 MB, malware-free), classifies documents by sensitivity, assigns a unique application ID, sets status to Submitted, records history/audit data, and triggers the submission notification.

purpose: Verify that incomplete required application information keeps the application unsubmitted and identifies missing information.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role and starts submitting a patent application with one or more required fields missing.
action_or_input: Applicant submits the application with incomplete required information.
expected_result: PMS identifies the missing information and keeps the application unsubmitted.

purpose: Verify that a document failing format, size, or malware validation is rejected while preserving valid prior application state.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role and a valid prior application/draft state exists.
action_or_input: Applicant provides a document that is non-PDF, 50 MB or larger, or fails malware validation.
expected_result: PMS rejects that document and keeps the valid prior application state.

purpose: Verify that an unavailable external validation dependency prevents treating the application as accepted unless required validation completed.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role; an external validation dependency (such as malware scanning) is unavailable.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to submit a patent application while the external validation dependency is unavailable.
expected_result: PMS does not treat the application as successfully accepted unless required validation has completed, retaining the prior valid draft/application state.

purpose: Verify that an authorized Applicant can view current status, progress, and recorded history of their own application.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role and access to the selected patent application.
action_or_input: Applicant selects one of their patent applications in the personal application-tracking view.
expected_result: PMS displays current status/progress and recorded application history available to the Applicant without modifying business or application state.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can navigate among their own applications and available history entries.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role and access to multiple owned applications and history entries.
action_or_input: Applicant navigates between different owned applications and available history entries.
expected_result: PMS displays the status, progress, and available history for each selected owned application without modifying application data.

purpose: Verify that PMS blocks an Applicant from viewing an application record they are not authorized to access.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role but lacks authorization for the selected application record.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to open or view an unauthorized application record.
expected_result: PMS blocks access and no application data is modified.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can add or update inventor details, ownership shares, consents, and electronic signatures and notify affected parties.
preconditions: Applicant has access to the application and current role/status permits inventor and agreement updates; electronic signatures are permitted/configured where used.
action_or_input: Applicant adds or updates inventor information and ownership shares, and provides/records required inventor consent and valid electronic signature.
expected_result: PMS validates inventor information, ownership percentages, consent, and electronic signature, records agreement information, updates agreement-completion state, and notifies affected parties when inventor information changes.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can update the inventor set or ownership shares prior to filing when permitted by access and state rules.
preconditions: Application is pre-filing and current role/status rules permit modifying the inventor set or ownership shares.
action_or_input: Applicant updates the inventor set or ownership shares before filing.
expected_result: PMS validates and stores the updated inventor set or ownership shares and notifies affected parties as applicable.

purpose: Verify that invalid inventor information, ownership percentages, consent, or signature validation is rejected without altering prior valid data.
preconditions: Applicant has access to an application with prior valid inventor/agreement data.
action_or_input: Applicant submits invalid inventor information, invalid ownership percentages, missing/invalid consent, or an invalid electronic signature.
expected_result: PMS prevents the affected change from being accepted and retains the prior valid inventor/agreement data.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant or Attorney can search prior-art sources, view ranked results, attach selected references, and log the search session.
preconditions: Actor (Applicant or Attorney) has a valid PMS role and external search access/integration is available where required.
action_or_input: Actor enters or optimizes search terms/classification information, runs the search, reviews ranked results, selects references, and attaches them to the application.
expected_result: PMS queries available sources, displays ranked results, attaches selected references to the application, and logs the search session.

purpose: Verify that an actor can refine keywords or classification mapping and repeat the prior-art search.
preconditions: Actor has a valid PMS role and has executed an initial prior-art search.
action_or_input: Actor refines search keywords or classification mapping and repeats the search.
expected_result: PMS re-queries available sources with the refined criteria and displays updated ranked results.

purpose: Verify that an unavailable external prior-art source is not represented as successfully queried and no fabricated results are recorded.
preconditions: Actor has a valid PMS role; an external patent/publication search source is unavailable.
action_or_input: Actor initiates a prior-art search requiring the unavailable external source.
expected_result: PMS does not represent the external source as successfully queried, does not fabricate or record unsupported results, and keeps existing PMS data intact.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can revise an eligible application addressing Director feedback within 60 days and start a new review cycle.
preconditions: Application status is Needs Revision or Rejected; the 60-day resubmission period from the decision date has not expired.
action_or_input: Applicant reviews Director feedback, edits permitted content/documents and uploads revised versions addressing the feedback, and submits the revision.
expected_result: PMS validates that the revision addresses Director feedback, applies document/version rules, records the revised version, and starts a new review cycle.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can save draft revisions before final resubmission while the permitted revision state remains active.
preconditions: Application status is Needs Revision or Rejected and the 60-day resubmission period has not expired.
action_or_input: Applicant edits permitted content/documents and saves the revision without submitting final resubmission.
expected_result: PMS saves the draft revision while keeping the permitted revision state active for subsequent resubmission.

purpose: Verify that an expired 60-day resubmission deadline sets status to Expired and rejects late resubmission.
preconditions: Application has status Needs Revision or Rejected and the 60-day resubmission period has expired.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to resubmit the revised application after the 60-day deadline has expired.
expected_result: PMS changes the application status to Expired and does not accept the late resubmission.

purpose: Verify that a resubmission failing to address recorded Director feedback is rejected while retaining the prior valid state.
preconditions: Application status is Needs Revision or Rejected and the 60-day resubmission period has not expired.
action_or_input: Applicant submits a revision that does not address the recorded Director feedback.
expected_result: PMS rejects the resubmission and retains the prior valid application state.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can withdraw an eligible pre-filing application with a reason and required consent, setting status to Withdrawn.
preconditions: Application has not reached Filed status; current status is withdrawal-eligible; co-inventor consent is recorded where required by the applicable process.
action_or_input: Applicant selects withdraw, enters a withdrawal reason, provides/records required co-inventor consent where applicable, and confirms withdrawal.
expected_result: PMS verifies pre-filing and status eligibility, records co-inventor consent if required, sets status to Withdrawn, removes the application from the active queue, and records withdrawal history/status change.

purpose: Verify that withdrawal is blocked when the application's current status is not withdrawal-eligible.
preconditions: Application is in a status that is not withdrawal-eligible (or is already Filed).
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to withdraw the ineligible application.
expected_result: PMS blocks withdrawal and retains the application in its prior valid state.

purpose: Verify that PCC_ADMIN can assign a Submitted application to an eligible non-conflicted Director, moving status to Under Review.
preconditions: Application status is Submitted; PCC_ADMIN is authorized; target Director is not an inventor on the application and matches expertise/workload/COI rules.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN evaluates Director expertise, workload, and conflict-of-interest constraints and confirms assignment of an eligible Director.
expected_result: PMS prevents assignment if Director or PCC_ADMIN is an inventor, records the assignment, sets status to Under Review, notifies the Director, and initiates the review deadline.

purpose: Verify that configured automatic routing can assign a Submitted application using expertise, workload, and COI rules.
preconditions: Application status is Submitted and configured automatic routing is enabled with an eligible non-conflicted Director.
action_or_input: Automatic routing evaluates Director expertise, workload, and conflict-of-interest constraints and assigns the Submitted application.
expected_result: PMS records the assignment, sets status to Under Review, notifies the Director, and initiates the review deadline.

purpose: Verify that when no eligible Director assignment is available, status remains Submitted and an exceptional case is recorded/raised.
preconditions: Application status is Submitted and no eligible non-conflicted Director is available.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN or automatic routing attempts to assign the Submitted application when no eligible assignee exists.
expected_result: PMS does not commit an invalid/conflicted assignment, leaves application status as Submitted, and records/raises the exceptional case for PCC_ADMIN handling.

purpose: Verify that an assigned non-conflicted Director can approve a reviewed application with at least 50 characters of justification within 15 business days.
preconditions: Director is the assigned, non-conflicted reviewer; application status is Under Review; review is within the 15-business-day review period.
action_or_input: Director reviews application details and documents, selects Approve, enters a detailed justification of at least 50 characters, and submits within 15 business days.
expected_result: PMS records the Approve decision, justification, and audit trail, making the application eligible for attorney assignment.

purpose: Verify that a Director can select Reject or Needs Revision with at least 50 characters of justification and send detailed feedback to the Applicant.
preconditions: Director is the assigned, non-conflicted reviewer; application status is Under Review; review is within 15 business days.
action_or_input: Director reviews the application, selects Reject or Needs Revision, enters a detailed justification of at least 50 characters, and submits.
expected_result: PMS records the Reject or Needs Revision decision, justification, and audit trail, and triggers detailed feedback to the Applicant.

purpose: Verify that a review decision missing the required justification (fewer than 50 characters or blank) is rejected without changing application state.
preconditions: Director is assigned to the application in Under Review.
action_or_input: Director submits a review decision without a justification of at least 50 characters.
expected_result: PMS does not accept the decision and leaves the application state unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a conflicted or unassigned Director cannot submit a review decision.
preconditions: Application is Under Review; requesting Director is either not assigned to the application or has a conflict of interest.
action_or_input: Unassigned or conflicted Director attempts to submit a review decision.
expected_result: PMS blocks the review decision submission and does not alter the application state.

purpose: Verify that a Director can review costs and record an within-threshold budget decision for an Approved application.
preconditions: Application status is Approved; proposed filing, attorney, and administrative costs are within the configured threshold; budget availability validation succeeds where available.
action_or_input: Director reviews filing fees, attorney fees, administrative costs, and available budget data, and records a within-threshold budget decision.
expected_result: PMS records the within-threshold budget decision, financial/authorization metadata, and audit trail, and triggers the applicable budget notification.

purpose: Verify that within-threshold review supports Budget Approved or Budget Rejected, while above-threshold costs escalate to Escalated.
preconditions: Application status is Approved; budget availability checks pass where required.
action_or_input: Director records Budget Approved or Budget Rejected within threshold, or submits a cost exceeding the configured threshold.
expected_result: Within-threshold cases record Budget Approved or Budget Rejected; above-threshold cases set state to Escalated and route/escalate to the applicable higher authority with financial/authorization metadata and notification.

purpose: Verify that PMS does not record budget approval when required budget-availability validation fails.
preconditions: Application status is Approved; budget-availability data is required and available, and validation indicates insufficient/unavailable budget.
action_or_input: Director attempts to approve budget for the application despite failed budget-availability validation.
expected_result: PMS does not record approval and preserves prior valid state.

purpose: Verify that PCC_ADMIN can assign an approved-panel Attorney to an Approved application and notify the Attorney.
preconditions: Application status is Approved; PCC_ADMIN is authorized; selected Attorney is on the approved panel with no conflict of interest.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN evaluates approved-panel status, expertise, workload, conflict-of-interest, and permitted Applicant preference, selects an eligible Attorney, and records the assignment.
expected_result: PMS records the Attorney assignment subject to Attorney acceptance/decline and notifies the Attorney.

purpose: Verify preferred-Attorney consideration when in approved panel and non-panel assignment when a recorded institutional exception permits.
preconditions: Application status is Approved; PCC_ADMIN is authorized; either a preferred Attorney is in the approved panel or a recorded institutional exception permits a non-panel Attorney.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN selects an approved-panel preferred Attorney or assigns a non-panel Attorney covered by a recorded institutional exception.
expected_result: PMS considers the preferred Attorney only when in the approved panel, permits the non-panel Attorney only when an approved institutional exception is recorded, records the assignment, and notifies the Attorney.

purpose: Verify that conflict-of-interest, unapproved non-panel status without exception, or other constraint failures block assignment.
preconditions: Application status is Approved; candidate Attorney has a conflict of interest or is off-panel without a recorded institutional exception.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN attempts to assign the conflicting or unapproved-panel Attorney.
expected_result: PMS blocks the assignment and does not commit any invalid assignment.

purpose: Verify that an assigned Attorney can accept an assignment and PMS records it as accepted / Attorney Assigned.
preconditions: An active assignment to the Attorney exists.
action_or_input: Attorney opens the newly assigned application, reviews the assignment, and chooses Accept.
expected_result: PMS records the acceptance response and updates the assignment/application state as accepted / Attorney Assigned.

purpose: Verify that an assigned Attorney can decline an assignment, updating status to Pending Review as applicable and notifying PCC_ADMIN.
preconditions: An active assignment to the Attorney exists.
action_or_input: Attorney opens the newly assigned application, reviews the assignment, and chooses Decline.
expected_result: PMS records the decline response, sets Pending Review as applicable, notifies PCC_ADMIN, and leaves unrelated assignments unchanged.

purpose: Verify that PMS rejects an acceptance or decline response when no active assignment exists for the Attorney.
preconditions: No active assignment exists for the Attorney on the target application.
action_or_input: Attorney attempts to accept or decline an assignment that is not actively assigned to them.
expected_result: PMS does not accept the response and leaves unrelated assignments unchanged.

purpose: Verify that an assigned Attorney can record a patentability opinion with a supported recommendation and notify relevant stakeholders.
preconditions: Attorney has the assigned application and required access.
action_or_input: Attorney reviews the application, performs/records prior-art research, evaluates novelty, non-obviousness, and utility, writes a detailed patentability opinion, and selects File Patent, Do Not File, or Needs Amendment.
expected_result: PMS records the detailed patentability opinion and selected recommendation and notifies relevant stakeholders.

purpose: Verify that an Attorney can request additional information or an extension where supported by PMS and the applicable process.
preconditions: Attorney has the assigned application and PMS/the applicable process supports requesting additional information or an extension.
action_or_input: Attorney requests additional information or an extension during patentability assessment.
expected_result: PMS records the request for additional information or extension according to supported process behavior.

purpose: Verify that PMS does not finalize a patentability opinion that lacks one of the supported recommendations.
preconditions: Attorney has the assigned application.
action_or_input: Attorney attempts to finalize a patentability opinion without selecting File Patent, Do Not File, or Needs Amendment.
expected_result: PMS does not finalize the opinion and retains any prior valid legal-review record.

purpose: Verify that an Attorney can prepare, validate, externally file, and record confirmation for an application, setting status to Filed.
preconditions: Required approvals and budget allocation are complete; inventor agreements are complete; Attorney has filing authority/access; package passes available validation rules.
action_or_input: Attorney prepares the filing package, provides required justification if international, submits externally to the patent office, and records external filing ID, filing date, and confirmation.
expected_result: PMS validates package format against available standards, records external filing ID, filing date, confirmation, and justification (if international), sets status to Filed, records audit/history, and triggers filing confirmation.

purpose: Verify national vs. international filing handling where international filing includes required additional justification.
preconditions: Filing prerequisites are complete and Attorney has filing authority/access.
action_or_input: Attorney prepares and records a national filing or an international filing with required additional justification.
expected_result: PMS applies national or international requirements accordingly, capturing additional justification for international filings and recording filing confirmation and Filed status.

purpose: Verify that PMS blocks filing when required approval, budget, or inventor-agreement prerequisites are missing.
preconditions: Attorney has access, but required approval, budget allocation, or inventor agreements are incomplete/missing.
action_or_input: Attorney attempts to proceed with filing before prerequisites are satisfied.
expected_result: PMS blocks filing and no false external filing success is recorded.

purpose: Verify that PMS does not mark an application Filed when external submission or confirmation is not obtained.
preconditions: Prerequisites are satisfied, but external submission fails or filing confirmation is not obtained.
action_or_input: Attorney attempts to record filing without confirmed external submission.
expected_result: PMS does not represent the filing as successfully Filed and leaves prior application state intact.

purpose: Verify that an Attorney can record an official patent-office office action, creating/updating office-action tracking and triggering notification.
preconditions: Application/family record exists and Attorney has access; received communication is an office action.
action_or_input: Attorney records communication type (Office Action), date, details, and supporting document/identifier.
expected_result: PMS logs the communication, creates/updates office-action tracking information for response tracking, and triggers the office-action notification.

purpose: Verify that non-office-action official patent-office communications are logged without starting an office-action response path.
preconditions: Application/family record exists and Attorney has access; received communication is not an office action.
action_or_input: Attorney records a non-office-action official communication type, date, details, and supporting document/identifier.
expected_result: PMS logs the official communication without initiating an office-action response path.

purpose: Verify that invalid or unrelated communication data is not attached to another application or alter unrelated application state.
preconditions: Attorney has access to an application record.
action_or_input: Attorney submits invalid or unrelated patent-office communication data referencing a mismatched/invalid application.
expected_result: PMS rejects attaching the invalid/unrelated communication to another application and leaves unrelated application state unchanged.

purpose: Verify that an Attorney can prepare a draft office-action response, route for required Applicant review, finalize after approval, and record external submission.
preconditions: Recorded office action exists; Attorney has access; applicable deadline data is available; Applicant review is required and subsequently approved.
action_or_input: Attorney prepares draft response, routes for required Applicant review, finalizes response after Applicant approval is recorded, submits externally, and records submission/status.
expected_result: PMS makes draft available for Applicant review when required, records response submission and status after required approval, and updates response tracking and audit/history information.

purpose: Verify that an Attorney can record/file an extension request when additional time is needed and permitted by the applicable process.
preconditions: Recorded office action exists; Attorney has access; additional time is needed and the applicable process permits an extension.
action_or_input: Attorney records or files an extension request for the office action.
expected_result: PMS records the extension request and updates tracking/history information accordingly.

purpose: Verify that PMS does not mark a response submitted without required Applicant approval (when applicable) or a submission record.
preconditions: Office action response requires Applicant approval (which is missing) or lacks a submission record.
action_or_input: Attorney attempts to mark the office-action response as submitted without required Applicant approval or submission record.
expected_result: PMS does not mark the response as submitted and records no unsupported submission.

purpose: Verify that a missed office-action response deadline follows deadline/escalation rules without inventing a legal outcome.
preconditions: Office-action response deadline has passed without recorded submission.
action_or_input: System/workflow evaluates the missed office-action response deadline.
expected_result: Deadline/escalation rules apply without PMS inferring or inventing a legal outcome.

purpose: Verify that PCC_ADMIN can monitor calculated deadlines, 30/15/5-day alerts, and escalations and log deadline/escalation handling.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN has an active authorized role; deadline rules/data are available for review, revision, office-action, or maintenance deadlines.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN opens the deadline/pending-action monitoring view, reviews upcoming/missed deadlines and escalation records, and routes or handles delayed-action exceptional cases within PMS scope.
expected_result: PMS calculates/maintains applicable deadlines, generates configured 30/15/5-day alerts and triggers notifications where applicable, records PCC_ADMIN handling/routing, and logs deadline-tracking/escalation activity.

purpose: Verify that when deadline rules or data are unavailable, PMS flags the item rather than fabricating a deadline.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN has an active authorized role; deadline rules or required data are unavailable for an item.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN views deadlines where deadline rules or data are missing/unavailable.
expected_result: PMS does not fabricate a deadline and leaves the item flagged as requiring applicable data/configuration.

purpose: Verify that a missed deadline escalates per configured chain without inferring external legal consequences.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN has an active authorized role; a tracked deadline has been missed with a configured escalation chain.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN reviews or processes a missed-deadline escalation record.
expected_result: PMS escalates according to the configured chain and logs the activity without inferring external or legal consequences.

purpose: Verify post-grant maintenance tracking, renewal request, recording approved maintenance action, renewal history, and next cycle scheduling.
preconditions: Patent status is Granted; maintenance schedule rules/data are available; Director has recorded a Renew decision via UC-PMS-018.
action_or_input: PMS activates post-grant tracking and calculates schedule; Attorney monitors deadline, requests renewal decision, and after Renew decision records maintenance action, transaction info, and resulting status.
expected_result: PMS maintains renewal history, records the maintenance action/transaction/status, and schedules the next maintenance cycle.

purpose: Verify that when the Director records Do Not Renew, no renewal maintenance action is recorded as approved.
preconditions: Patent status is Granted and Director has recorded Do Not Renew for the maintenance deadline.
action_or_input: Attorney reviews the Do Not Renew decision for the upcoming maintenance deadline.
expected_result: No renewal maintenance action is recorded as approved and renewal history reflects the outcome.

purpose: Verify that PMS does not fabricate a maintenance schedule when schedule rules or data are unavailable.
preconditions: Patent status is Granted, but maintenance schedule rules or data are unavailable.
action_or_input: Post-grant tracking runs for the Granted patent without available maintenance schedule rules/data.
expected_result: PMS does not fabricate a maintenance schedule and records no unapproved maintenance action.

purpose: Verify that a Director can record a Renew decision for a patent in post-grant tracking before a maintenance deadline.
preconditions: Patent is in post-grant tracking (Granted) and a renewal decision is due/requested by Attorney.
action_or_input: Director reviews the patent and available maintenance information and selects Renew.
expected_result: PMS records the Renew decision for the maintenance cycle and makes it available to the Attorney for the next applicable maintenance action.

purpose: Verify that a Director can record Do Not Renew as an alternative renewal decision.
preconditions: Patent is in post-grant tracking (Granted) and a renewal decision is due/requested by Attorney.
action_or_input: Director reviews the patent and available maintenance information and selects Do Not Renew.
expected_result: PMS records the Do Not Renew decision for the maintenance cycle and makes it available to the Attorney.

purpose: Verify that PMS rejects a maintenance renewal decision when the patent is not in the applicable Granted/post-grant context.
preconditions: Target record is not in the applicable Granted/post-grant context.
action_or_input: Director attempts to record a Renew or Do Not Renew decision for a patent not in Granted/post-grant tracking.
expected_result: PMS does not accept or record the renewal decision.

purpose: Verify that an authorized user can upload a new document version, archive the previous version, log user/timestamp, and access prior versions.
preconditions: User has a valid PMS role and role/status rules permit uploading and accessing document versions.
action_or_input: Authorized user uploads a new document version and accesses a previous document version.
expected_result: PMS assigns the next version number, archives the previous version, records the modification user and timestamp, and allows authorized access to previous versions per role/status rules.

purpose: Verify role- and status-specific document editing/versioning rules, including Applicant editing restricted to Needs Revision.
preconditions: Applicant or another permitted role (Attorney/Director/PCC_ADMIN) accesses document/version management under applicable status rules.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to edit/upload application documents in Needs Revision status versus a non-Needs-Revision status, or another role acts within permitted status/role rules.
expected_result: Applicants can edit application documents only in Needs Revision status, and other roles may upload/access versions only where their role/status permission permits.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized document upload or version access is blocked and logged.
preconditions: User lacks role or status permission to upload or access the target document version.
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to upload a new document version or access a restricted previous version.
expected_result: PMS blocks the unauthorized upload or access, logs the event according to audit/security behavior, and creates or discloses no unauthorized document version.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can submit a licensing request linked to a patent/IP record and PMS routes and tracks it.
preconditions: Applicant has access to the relevant patent/IP record and routing target/process is determinable from configuration/policy.
action_or_input: Applicant selects request type (licensing), enters required request information, and submits the request.
expected_result: PMS routes the request to the appropriate committee or Director per institutional process and records the routing/tracking state.

purpose: Verify that a technology-transfer request uses the same submission flow with request type set to technology transfer.
preconditions: Applicant has access to the relevant patent/IP record and routing target/process is determinable.
action_or_input: Applicant selects request type (technology transfer), enters required request information, and submits the request.
expected_result: PMS submits, routes, and tracks the technology-transfer request consistently with the submission flow.

purpose: Verify that if routing target/process cannot be determined, PMS does not invent a committee decision.
preconditions: Applicant has access to the patent/IP record, but applicable routing target or process cannot be determined from configuration/policy.
action_or_input: Applicant submits a licensing or technology-transfer request when routing configuration/policy is undetermined.
expected_result: PMS does not invent a committee decision or unsupported review outcome.

purpose: Verify that a Director can review a routed licensing/technology-transfer request and record negotiation, agreement, financial info, and confidential license record.
preconditions: Request exists and Director is the applicable routing target; confidentiality controls and financial integration (where available) apply.
action_or_input: Director reviews the request information, and authorized PMS users record negotiation-process information and final agreement when available.
expected_result: PMS records negotiation and final-agreement information, updates/shares financial-system information where integration is available, and maintains the license record with confidentiality controls.

purpose: Verify that when institutional process routes to a committee instead of the Director, external committee decisions are not modeled as PMS actor decisions while resulting info may be recorded.
preconditions: Request is routed to an institutional committee per process.
action_or_input: Resulting committee information is provided for recording in PMS.
expected_result: Committee decision process remains outside defined PMS actors, and PMS may record resulting information with confidentiality controls without inventing unsupported decision outcomes.

purpose: Verify that PMS does not invent approval or rejection semantics not stated in the frozen Problem Statement.
preconditions: A licensing or technology-transfer request is under review/tracking in PMS.
action_or_input: Request is processed without an explicit PS-defined approval/rejection outcome.
expected_result: PMS does not invent unstated approval/rejection semantics or unsupported decision outcomes.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can file an appeal against a Rejected application within the allowed appeal period.
preconditions: Application status is Rejected and the configured/institutional appeal period has not expired.
action_or_input: Applicant selects appeal, enters grounds and justification for appeal, and submits.
expected_result: PMS validates appeal eligibility and timing and records the appeal as submitted for Director review.

purpose: Verify that an appeal for a non-Rejected application or outside the allowed appeal period is rejected without changing rejection state.
preconditions: Application is either not Rejected or the allowed appeal period has expired.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to submit an appeal for a non-Rejected application or after the appeal period expires.
expected_result: PMS does not accept the appeal and leaves the prior application/rejection state unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a Director can review an appeal and record Uphold Rejection and initiate the next applicable step.
preconditions: Submitted appeal exists and is assigned/available for Director review.
action_or_input: Director reviews the appeal and supporting documentation and selects Uphold Rejection.
expected_result: PMS records the Uphold Rejection outcome and initiates the next applicable process step where defined.

purpose: Verify that a Director can record Remand for Amendment or Modify Decision as alternative appeal outcomes.
preconditions: Submitted appeal exists and is assigned/available for Director review.
action_or_input: Director reviews the appeal and selects Remand for Amendment (or Modify Decision).
expected_result: PMS records Remand for Amendment (initiating next defined step) or Modify Decision (recording the outcome without inventing unspecified downstream states).

purpose: Verify that an unsupported appeal outcome is not accepted.
preconditions: Submitted appeal exists and is available for Director review.
action_or_input: An attempt is made to record an appeal outcome other than Uphold Rejection, Remand for Amendment, or Modify Decision.
expected_result: PMS does not accept the unsupported outcome.

purpose: Verify that PCC_ADMIN can generate system-wide reports/analytics, schedule/customize/export where supported, and log report access.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN has the active authorized role and recorded PMS data exists.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN selects report/analytics type and filters, generates output, and schedules, customizes, or exports where supported.
expected_result: PMS generates the requested authorized output using recorded PMS data and logs report access without changing business state.

purpose: Verify availability of supported report types (status/progress, financial/budget, deadlines/pending actions, inventors, portfolio, workload/assignment).
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN has the active authorized role.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN selects each supported report/analytics type (status/progress, financial/budget, deadlines/pending actions, inventors, portfolio, or workload/assignment).
expected_result: PMS generates the corresponding authorized report or analytics view and logs report access.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized data is excluded and unavailable data is not fabricated in system-wide reports.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN has the active authorized role; some data is restricted/unauthorized or unavailable.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN requests a report or analytics view where certain data is unauthorized or unavailable.
expected_result: PMS excludes unauthorized data, does not fabricate unavailable data, and logs report access without altering business state.

purpose: Verify that PCC_ADMIN can update PMS-specific roles or configuration while preserving role/access rules and single-active-PCC_ADMIN, and log audit.
preconditions: Exactly one active PCC_ADMIN exists and the actor is authorized.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN reviews PMS configuration and role assignments and creates/updates PMS-specific role mappings or configuration values within module scope.
expected_result: PMS validates role/access constraints and the single-active-PCC_ADMIN rule, updates configuration/role assignments consistently, and records the change for audit.

purpose: Verify configuring supported PMS parameters such as thresholds, deadlines, routing rules, escalation rules, or integration references.
preconditions: Exactly one active PCC_ADMIN exists and the actor is authorized.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN updates configurable PMS settings such as thresholds, deadlines, routing rules, escalation rules, or integration references within module scope.
expected_result: PMS validates constraints, updates the configuration consistently, and records the change for audit.

purpose: Verify that platform-wide account administration and HR master-data changes are outside PMS scope and not altered by this use case.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is using PMS administration.
action_or_input: An attempt is made to perform platform-wide account administration or HR master-data changes through PMS role/configuration management.
expected_result: Platform-wide account administration and HR master-data changes are outside PMS and no platform-level account/HR data is changed by this use case.

purpose: Verify that PCC_ADMIN can add, update, or remove approved attorney-panel entries and expertise mappings for assignment validation/routing.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is authorized.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN adds, updates, or removes approved-panel membership and expertise mappings within PMS scope.
expected_result: PMS records the maintained panel/expertise information and makes it available to attorney-assignment validation and routing.

purpose: Verify that institutional exceptions can be recorded separately when an assignment outside the panel is permitted.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is authorized and an institutional exception for an off-panel assignment applies.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN records an institutional exception permitting an assignment outside the approved panel.
expected_result: PMS records the institutional exception separately so it is available for assignment validation.

purpose: Verify that invalid or unauthorized attorney-panel changes are not committed.
preconditions: Panel update is invalid or actor is unauthorized.
action_or_input: An invalid or unauthorized attorney-panel change is submitted.
expected_result: PMS does not commit the invalid/unauthorized panel update and keeps prior panel/expertise data intact.

purpose: Verify that PCC_ADMIN can review workflow states/exceptions and resolve or route exceptional cases within PMS scope.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is authorized; workflow/exception records exist.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN reviews workflow state, pending actions, assignment conflicts, delayed items, and escalations, and resolves or routes an exceptional case within PMS authority/configuration.
expected_result: PMS records the handling or routing action and resulting tracking state within PMS scope.

purpose: Verify handling of specific exceptional cases such as no eligible assignee, conflict-of-interest cases, or delayed-action escalations.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is authorized; an application has no eligible assignee, a conflict of interest, or a delayed-action escalation.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN reviews and handles or routes the no-eligible-assignee, conflict-of-interest, or delayed-action escalation case.
expected_result: PMS records the handling/routing action and resulting tracking state within PMS scope.

purpose: Verify that PCC_ADMIN is not granted unstated legal, patent-office, payment, or higher-authority decision powers.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is viewing/handling an exceptional case.
action_or_input: An attempt is made to exercise an unstated legal, patent-office, financial-payment, or higher-authority decision power through PCC_ADMIN.
expected_result: PMS does not grant unstated decision power or invent unsupported external decisions.

purpose: Verify that an authorized actor (such as PCC_ADMIN) can filter, view, and review/export audit/compliance records with required fields.
preconditions: Actor has authorized access to audit/compliance information.
action_or_input: Actor selects application, time range, user, or action scope and views/reviews/exports audit records.
expected_result: PMS displays available audit records including required audit fields without altering audit data or business state.

purpose: Verify that a Director's audit access, where available, is restricted to their applicable authority or domain.
preconditions: Director has authorized audit access limited to their applicable authority/domain.
action_or_input: Director opens audit/compliance logs and selects scope.
expected_result: PMS displays only audit records within the Director's authorized authority/domain without altering audit data.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized access to audit/compliance logs is blocked.
preconditions: Requesting user is not authorized to view the requested audit/compliance logs.
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to view or export audit/compliance logs.
expected_result: PMS blocks access to the audit logs and leaves audit data and business state unchanged.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can review a draft office-action response and record approval so the Attorney can finalize/submit it.
preconditions: Applicable process requires Applicant review and a draft office-action response is available for Applicant review.
action_or_input: Applicant reviews the draft office-action response and records approval.
expected_result: PMS records Applicant approval of the response so the Attorney can finalize and submit it.

purpose: Verify that when Applicant review is not required by the applicable process, UC-PMS-029 is not invoked.
preconditions: Draft office-action response exists, and the applicable process does not require Applicant review.
action_or_input: Office-action response workflow proceeds without requiring Applicant approval.
expected_result: Applicant review use case is not required/invoked and the Attorney can proceed per UC-PMS-015.

purpose: Verify that if Applicant approval is not recorded, PMS does not treat the response as Applicant-approved.
preconditions: Applicable process requires Applicant review and Applicant approval has not been recorded.
action_or_input: Response is inspected or checked for approval status before Applicant approval is recorded.
expected_result: PMS does not treat the response as Applicant-approved and defines no alternate Applicant decision outcome.

purpose: Verify that an Applicant can select and view personal application reports restricted to their own applications.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role and owns patent applications.
action_or_input: Applicant selects personal reports and chooses an available personal application report.
expected_result: PMS restricts the dataset to the Applicant's own applications and displays the report without changing business state.

purpose: Verify that supported presentation or export options on personal reports work when authorized.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role and the report function supports presentation/export options.
action_or_input: Applicant uses available presentation or export options on their personal report.
expected_result: PMS provides the supported presentation or export option scoped to the Applicant's own applications without changing business state.

purpose: Verify that PMS blocks an Applicant from accessing another Applicant's report data.
preconditions: Applicant has a valid PMS role and attempts to access report data belonging to another Applicant.
action_or_input: Applicant requests or attempts to view another Applicant's report data.
expected_result: PMS blocks access to the other Applicant's report data and leaves business state unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a Director can select and view authorized reports/analytics within their domain and PMS logs report access.
preconditions: Director has an authorized PMS role.
action_or_input: Director selects a report/analytics function and chooses an available view within their scope.
expected_result: PMS generates output using PMS data within the Director's authorized scope/domain and logs report access without changing business state.

purpose: Verify that authorized scheduled, export, or customized report functions work within the Director's scope.
preconditions: Director has an authorized PMS role and scheduled/export/customized report functions are authorized.
action_or_input: Director schedules, exports, or customizes an authorized report within their domain.
expected_result: PMS generates or schedules the authorized report within the Director's scope and logs report access.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized report scope outside the Director's domain/authorization is blocked.
preconditions: Director has an authorized PMS role with restricted domain scope.
action_or_input: Director attempts to access report or analytics data outside their authorized scope/domain.
expected_result: PMS blocks unauthorized report scope and leaves business state unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a Director can view workflow states, pending actions, and oversight information within their domain.
preconditions: Director has an authorized role and domain scope.
action_or_input: Director opens workflow oversight/dashboard information and selects the relevant workflow/application scope.
expected_result: PMS displays workflow states, pending actions, and oversight information within the Director's domain without changing business state.

purpose: Verify that workflow or application oversight information outside the Director's domain is not disclosed.
preconditions: Director has an authorized role with a specific domain scope.
action_or_input: Director requests or views oversight data covering applications outside their domain.
expected_result: PMS does not disclose out-of-domain information and leaves business state unchanged.

purpose: Verify that an authorized Attorney can record legal advice for an application and associate it with history/audit records.
preconditions: Attorney has a valid role and access to the application.
action_or_input: Attorney selects the application/context and records legal advice note/opinion information.
expected_result: PMS records the legal advice and associates it with the application history/audit record as applicable.

purpose: Verify that recording legal advice can occur at different lifecycle stages without imposing a new application-state transition.
preconditions: Attorney has a valid role and access to an application at a supported lifecycle stage.
action_or_input: Attorney records legal advice at a different lifecycle stage of the application.
expected_result: PMS records the legal advice and associates it with history/audit records without imposing a new application-state transition.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized access or an invalid application reference prevents storing legal advice.
preconditions: Actor lacks access to the application or provides an invalid application reference.
action_or_input: User attempts to record legal advice without application access or with an invalid application reference.
expected_result: PMS prevents the legal advice record from being stored and leaves unrelated application state unchanged.
